name: All in Sequence
source:
You wake up cold and alone in an empty office building. Your surroundings have been ravaged by something, or somethings. It's up to you to find a way out.

[From [url=https://archaeornis.itch.io/all-in-sequence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一座空荡荡的办公楼里醒来，寒冷而孤独。你的周围环境已经被某种东西破坏了。找到出路就看你了。

[来自[url=https://archaeornis.itch.io/all-in-sequence]Itch.io[/url]]
